corrections.reason: The word wrapping from L04 is አሳልፈህ (gerundive with 2nd person masculine suffix -ህ); the image clearly shows ህ, not ሕ.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 22:31 phrasing uses the cognate infinitive/gerundive form ሰአለ ሰኢሎ; the image clearly shows the loop of ሎ on the right leg.
Traditional chapter section heading for John 14 ('Concerning the Way of Salvation' — በእንተ ፍኖት ዘድኅነት); the glyph ፍኖት was misread as ፉፈያት.
Translating ውስተ ቤተ አቡየ ('In my Father's house' — ባባቴ ቤት, matching L28 and L34); the initial character is clearly ባ.
Cross-reference to ኢይክል [ተሊወተከ] (John 13:37, cited in Col 1 L14). The line ends with ኢይ wrapping to ክል on L23.
Completes ኢይክል መልስ ('This is the reply to ኢይክል [ተሊወተከ]'). The image clearly shows ክል at the start of L23.
Amharic negative jussive አይሸበርባችሁ ('let it not be troubled in you', matching L14 and L25); the image shows 1st-order አ without the bottom ring of ኢ.
Amharic temporal construction ከ + አዘጋጀሁላችሁ contracts to ካዘጋጀሁላችሁ በኋላ; the shortened right leg of ካ is visible in the image.

Explaining the previous line ('እመጽእ በረድኤት እነሥእክሙ በሞት'): 'His coming by grace (በረድኤት መምጣቱን) is called second (ካዕበ) relative to his coming in death (በሞት ለመምጣቱ)'. The glyph at the end of L19 is በሞ wrapping to ት on L20.
In the printed image, L32 ends with እ and ንከ begins L33.
In the printed image, L33 begins with ንከ completing እንከ from the end of L32.
